description:
A callable value can be constructed once with one capture environment yet have multiple compatible specialized executable members. Current transport materialization chooses one BackendCallableEntry, pinning an ABI that later receives a different invocation shape.

Signal
compiler2_jit_runs_range_reduce2_first_acc_bridge_from_native_artifacts calls a closure whose chosen Entry expects [RawInt, RawAtom] with the alternative accumulator shape and aborts in fz_unbox_atom. Backend evidence has one Lambda construction for CallableId(1), capture_count 1 / capture_reprs [ValueRef], and two entries differing only in specialized semantic argument surface.

Strategy
Introduce a producer-scoped callable value member set, validated to share callable producer and capture surface. Carry it through transport publication and Lambda/FunctionRef value identity. Native materializes one value-facing closure boundary which dispatches boxed semantic arguments among those members, invokes each target through its authoritative ABI, and reboxes its result. This is NOT BackendCallableDispatchSet, which is a later callsite analysis union and may combine distinct closure values/environments.

Acceptance
The range-reduce JIT regression passes without widening target lanes, and runtime member selection is proven to derive only from the one constructed callable value's validated member set.
title: Represent multi-specialization members on one callable value
